title: Grateful Dead Live at Ungano's Night Club on 1970-02-12
taper: Any/all editing, fades, NR, hiss elimination, phase shifting/"time smear" correction, jitter elimination, and +/-2 dB max. EQ were performed using 100% digital-only processing (24-bit/96 kHz data stream) at Serafin Station Studio B
source: SBD > 2-track RTR @ 15 i.p.s. > PCM > ? > D > SSSB

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear soundboard capture of an early ’70 set with a raucous Casey Jones and solid Black Peter/ Saint Stephen performances.
ai_review.review: The tape is praised for its crisp, almost “crystal” sound quality despite being an early‑show recording, and listeners note strong playing on Black Peter, Saint Stephen and a notably loud crowd ending on Casey Jones. While a few reviewers call the show merely decent or “just a tape,” overall the audio shines and makes it worth a spin.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews are split – two give 5‑star praise for audio and key songs, one rates it average (3 stars) and another is outright negative, leading to a moderate overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Multiple reviewers describe the tape as crystal‑clear and great sounding; one notes an especially large crowd sound on the ending of Casey Jones, but no major flaws are reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Early‑1970 set noted for its cowboy‑flavored covers and solid mid‑set numbers; the show is considered a decent warm‑up to later epic performances.
